The blue line and red line intersect between 2013 and 2014. At the 2014 mark, the blue line is above the red line. The blue marker at 2014 has a data label '1257.35' above it.
At the 2015 mark, the red line is at its lowest point on the chart. The blue line is higher than the red line at this position.
At the 2017 mark, the blue line is above the red line. The blue marker has a data label '1911.76' above it. The red marker has a data label '491.78' below it.
From 2019 to 2020, the blue and red lines converge and become very close to each other, with the red line slightly above or overlapping the blue line at the 2020 mark.
